newsitem.title: USA: Chiron launches breast cancer test in U.S..
newsitem.headline: Chiron launches breast cancer test in U.S..

text.p: Chiron Diagnostics, a unit of Chiron Corp, said Thursday it has launched its ACS:180 BR, a blood test for the breast cancer antigen CA 27.29.

Chiron said that the test received 510(k) clearance from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration this week and is now available in the United States to physicians to monitor their patients with metastatic breast cancer.
According to the company, the test allows clinicians to monitor the cancer's progression or regression in response to treatment.
